verdictRationale: The frozen subject is integrity-valid and unchanged, but two unresolved major correctness findings materially affect private-ingress deployment and approved stage-gate semantics. The unchanged subject must not proceed to AFF-B as final.

findings.title: DU-15 Application Gateway network-isolation evidence state cannot satisfy both preflight and the Bicep module gate.
evidence: 5-coding/infra/modules/ingress/main.bicep:158 sets featureGatePassed only when featureRegistrationEvidenceState == APPROVED.
5-coding/tests/iac/fixtures/preflight-valid.json:14-16 uses Registered values for the same evidence map.
5-coding/deploy/README.md:259 requires DU-15 Application Gateway network-isolation feature registration to be evidenced.
findings.consequence: A correctly registered subscription value will fail the nested module allowed-values contract or leave featureGatePassed false; an APPROVED value satisfies the module but fails preflight. DU-15 private ingress is therefore not reliably deployable under the retained procedure.
findings.requiredRemediation: Align DU-15 evidence semantics end-to-end, for example by accepting and testing Registered in the ingress module or by mapping registered evidence to an explicit approval state before deployment. Add a selected-DU-15 preflight/template test that proves the deployable parameter object can pass both preflight and ARM validation.

findings.title: Preflight and deployment instructions require every owner-input sentinel to be replaced before any selected deployment unit, contrary to the approved target-stage gate.
evidence: 4-implementation-plan/stratton-implementation-plan.md:77 says only values needed for the target stage may proceed and later unknowns remain blockers.
5-coding/deploy/README.md:17 requires every REQUIRED_OWNER_INPUT sentinel to be replaced before any Azure command.
5-coding/deploy/README.md:58 says the human owner must replace every sentinel in the execution parameter file.
5-coding/tests/iac/Invoke-DeploymentPreflight.ps1:138 calls Add-SentinelViolations on the entire parameter object.
5-coding/tests/iac/Infra.Tests.ps1:195-200 verifies that sentinel-bearing environment parameter files are rejected wholesale.
findings.consequence: The implementation changes the approved incremental stage-admission model into an all-values-up-front gate. That can block an otherwise authorised early DU run and obscures which owner evidence is actually required for the selected stage.
findings.requiredRemediation: Revise the deployment procedure, preflight logic and tests so the selected DU plus global prerequisites are fully checked while later-stage sentinels remain explicitly fail closed and unusable until their own stage is authorised.

findings.title: The tool-version lock retained in the frozen release still records status IN_PROGRESS.
evidence: 5-coding/tooling/tool-versions.json:49 says tool versions are rechecked before the Phase 5 candidate is frozen.
5-coding/stratton-build-report.md:5-8 presents the candidate as READY_FOR_ASSURANCE with full local validation PASS.
findings.consequence: The exact versions are present and matched by retained prerequisite evidence, but the retained lock status is stale for a frozen assurance candidate.
findings.requiredRemediation: In the next candidate, refresh the tool-version record status or document why IN_PROGRESS remains the intended immutable state after freeze.

findings.title: Retained release-evidence validation does not itself record the final self-excluding hash verification step described by the package README.
evidence: 5-coding/README.md:48-64 says final report generation is followed by New-Phase5Hashes.ps1 and Test-ReleaseEvidence.ps1.
5-coding/validation/Invoke-LocalValidation.ps1:351-367 records the Release step as New-ReleaseManifest.ps1.
5-coding/stratton-build-report.md:43 reports release-evidence PASS against that log.
findings.consequence: AFF-A independently verified the final manifest in this review, but the Phase 5 retained validation evidence is ambiguous about whether the final hash manifest and Test-ReleaseEvidence pass were retained as part of the validation run.
findings.requiredRemediation: Retain a release-integrity evidence record for final hash generation and Test-ReleaseEvidence, or adjust the documentation/build report so the boundary of release-evidence PASS is unambiguous.
